risks.title: Plant data extract volumes exceed integration middleware capacity
risks.mitigation: Batch extraction windows redesigned; capacity testing scheduled ahead of Site 3 rehearsal.

risks.title: Key finance super-user unavailable during UAT window
risks.mitigation: Backup super-user being identified and cross-trained by the customer's finance lead.

risks.title: Sourcing module rollout depends on Northstar cutover sequencing
risks.mitigation: Joint sequencing workshop planned with both program managers to de-risk the shared cutover window.

risks.title: Supplier master data quality below rollout threshold
risks.mitigation: Data cleansing sprint underway with supplier data steward ahead of Wave 1.

risks.title: Peak-season load testing not yet scheduled
risks.mitigation: Load test slot reserved in staging environment for early September.

risks.title: Loyalty partner API contract still pending legal review
risks.mitigation: Legal review escalated; interim mock endpoint in use to avoid schedule impact.

risks.title: Regulatory reporting rules interpretation disputed by compliance
risks.mitigation: Working session with customer compliance team scheduled to align on interpretation before validation resumes.

risks.title: Historical telemetry data has significant gaps for two field regions
risks.mitigation: Gap-filling approach agreed with customer; residual gaps to be documented as known limitations.

risks.title: Cloud analytics platform licensing costs trending above budget
risks.mitigation: Usage-based cost tracking dashboard introduced; monthly review with customer finance.

risks.title: Advisor scheduling system exposes limited integration API
risks.mitigation: Vendor engaged to extend API scope; interim polling-based integration in place.

risks.title: Penetration test findings could delay GA readiness
risks.mitigation: Remediation sprint reserved immediately following penetration test results.

risks.title: Data-governance sign-off delay has paused program execution
risks.mitigation: Executive escalation submitted to customer compliance office; weekly status check-ins established.

risks.title: Clinical records vendor unresponsive on integration timelines
risks.mitigation: Escalation path opened through the customer's vendor management office.

risks.title: Post-go-live defect backlog from pilot region
risks.mitigation: All pilot defects resolved prior to full fleet rollout; retrospective completed.

risks.title: Mobile checkout conversion below target in staging benchmarks
risks.mitigation: UX refinements applied; benchmark re-run confirmed target conversion achieved.
